corrections.why: The Willhite page cited for this record describes Powderhorn, about nine miles northeast of Woodland, which is a different lookout with its own history. The Kittitas County Davis Peak site has its own register entry (US 1396) and does not share the Powderhorn name.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The 1968 year agrees across sources. The register and SummitPost say removed, the Fire Lookout Association says destroyed, and Willhite says destroyed or removed.

sources.title: Davis Peak - Salmon La Sac Hiking Trails

notes_for_editor: Build (1934) and end (1968) agree across sources; the wording of the end varies (removed or destroyed). Staffing: Lumsden (1944, 16 years in total, last season 1965 per Willhite) is in the register and Willhite. The Fire Lookout Association lists Aaron Jurgens for 1933, a year before the 1934 cab, and Marianna Kearney for 1964, with no context; both are kept as flagged events and the story says so. The 'Powderhorn/Davis Peak' alias in the record comes from a Willhite page that describes a different lookout near Woodland; see corrections. What remains on site is described only by SummitPost, a climbing site, and no Forest Service record was read. Access: trailhead directions only; no closure notice was read. Used 1 WebSearch and 5 page reads. The register and Willhite spell the place Rosyln; the story uses Roslyn.
